module.purpose: Provides utilities for reflecting and traversing the React fiber tree to locate mounted fibers, host instances, siblings, ancestors, and containment relationships used by reconciler and devtools.
module.summary: This module is a bag of pure-ish helper functions operating on React's internal Fiber tree. It offers tree reflection capabilities: finding the nearest mounted fiber, extracting suspense/activity dehydrated instances, walking up to container or host parent, locating current fiber via slow path when alternates exist, drilling down to host components/text, computing fragment siblings, and determining precedence or containment between fibers. It relies on Fiber tag constants, flags, and a feature flag for text node refs. Several functions use module-level scratch variables for search state, making them non-reentrant.
module.businessContext: Core React reconciler internals. Enables correct host instance discovery and portal/ref logic. Failure breaks rendering, devtools, and Suspense/Activity hydration.
